name: trdsql-structured-reader-diagnostics-and-row-cd87
instr:
trdsql lacks structured malformed-input diagnostics and deterministic handling of recoverable records. Carry issue accounting through readers, analysis, and command execution. Keep diagnostics out of successful query output and preserve unconfigured behavior.

Every parser-authored `ReadIssue` must include its `Format`, `ReadStage`, monotonic logical record, best available physical location, and underlying error, without invented coordinates. `ReadStage` and `ReadPolicy` are integer types. `ReadIssueError` supports Go error unwrapping.

Stop returns only the first issue. Skip continues only across reader-established boundaries. Collect continues safely with bounded history. `RejectedRows` snapshots are independent under mutation and concurrency, with deterministic dropped counts.

Delimited, object, labeled, fixed-width, TBLN, slice, and row-number readers retain established schema, parsing, identity, and conversion semantics. Analysis returns accepted samples and deterministic retained, dropped, and total issue information. Command execution supports stop, skip, and collect, with diagnostics separate from query output. Identical options and malformed input produce the same issue order and totals through direct Reader use, Analyze, and CLI ingestion.

`InReadPolicy(policy) ReadOpt`, `InReadIssueSink(sink) ReadOpt`, `InRejectedRows(rows) ReadOpt`, and `(*AnalyzeOpts).ReadIssueSink(sink) *AnalyzeOpts` configure shared behavior. Unknown values passed to `ParseReadPolicy` fail be
